title: Assalamu Alaike Ya Sayeda
body:
Sayyada (4)
Ya taahera raazia marzia fatema shaafiya qairunnisa umm e abeeha sayyada
Assalam (8)
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
Alwida alwida sayyada alwida (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Jo bhi ansaar e Husain ibn e ALI qatl huwa
Girkey ghodey se zamee par Wo yehi kehta tha
Anta ummi Wa abii mamba fidaa e maula (2)
Kehrahey they yahi maqtool e jafaa
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
Alwida alwida sayyada alwida (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2) hurr chalaa jaanib e maqtal paye nusrat jis damm
Yu lagaa uth'tey ho jannat ki taraf uskey qadam
Jung kartey huwey jab narga e aadaa mey ghiraa (2)
Zaqm khaata raha aur kehta raha
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye aoun o Mohammad maaregaye (2)
Dono they aapke mehlaqa sayyada
3) rann mey jab aoun o Mohammad ki sawaari aayi
Zulm ki kaali ghataa unki saro par chaayi
Qush huwey dono shahaadat ki qabar hai laayii (2)
Dii sadaa dono ney ye qabl e qazaa
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye ugli jawaani Akbar dii (2)
Jedi maqnad hoyi e tabaa sayyada
4) shaah ka noor e nazar laqt e jigar aks e nabii
Ladkey maidaan mey Akbar ney sinaa jab khaayii
Aagaya moo ko jigar qalb mey tootii barchii (2)
Chup zabaa hogayi laasha bola
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
Alwida alwida sayyada alwida (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5) hokey bey baazu alamdaar e jarii kehta tha
Aarahii hai mujhey qushboo e janaab e zehra
Mauta mohlat mujhey dedey paye rabb e Kaaba (2)
Aaqri jumla ye Karney dey adaa
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
Alwida alwida sayyada alwida (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6) daf'atan jhooley se ek nanha mujaahid nikla
Qadd mey chota tha jigar hazrat e Abbas ka tha
Misl e Abbas Wo maidaan mey bey teyg ladaa (2)
Muskuraatey huwey asgar ney Kahaa
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Chakki peeskey zehra ney paala jisey (2)
Wo to pyaasa jahaa se gayaa sayyada
7) aaqri sajda e aaqir ki ghadi aa pahunchi
Zeen se aaye zamee par Jo Husain ibn e ali
Shimr e mal'oon ney gardan pey Jo shamsheer rakhi (2)
Girkey maula ka lahoo bol utha
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
Alwida alwida sayyada alwida (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8) kyu na rehan o raza nazr karey hum ye kalaam
Waaris e majlis e Shabbir Jo hai uskey naam
Taakey qush humse ho gaibat mey hamaara Wo imam (2)
Raat din hai ye wazeefa jiska
<<MINI>>
Assalam o alaike ya sayyada (4)
Alwida alwdia sayyada alwida (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Assalam (6)
